chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Ali ibn Bilal al-Mahlabi reported to me, who said: Ali ibn Abdullah ibn Asad al-Isfahani narrated to us, who said: Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi narrated to us, who said: Abdul Rahman ibn Abi Hashim narrated to us, who said: Yahya ibn al-Husayn al-Bajali narrated to me, from Abu Harun al-Abdi, from Zadhan, from Salman al-Farsi -- may Allah have mercy on him -- who said:

The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, came out on the Day of Arafah and said: "O people, indeed Allah has glorified Himself because of you on this day so that He may forgive you all generally, and forgive Ali in particular."

Then he said: "Come near me, O Ali." So Ali drew near him, and the Prophet took him by his hand. Then he said: "Indeed, the blessed one -- completely and truly blessed -- is the one who obeyed you and followed you after I have gone. And indeed, the wretched one -- completely and truly wretched -- is the one who disobeyed you and showed hostility toward you after I have gone."

key_terms.السعيد: The blessed/fortunate one (sa'id) -- one destined for felicity
key_terms.الشقي: The wretched one (shaqi) -- one destined for misery and perdition
key_terms.باهى: Mubahah -- glorified Himself, took pride in (used for Allah showing divine pleasure)
key_terms.تولاك: Followed your wilaya/guardianship (tawalla) -- accepted your spiritual and political authority

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about Imam Ali on the Day of Arafah?
ai.summary: In this hadith narrated by Salman al-Farsi, the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) addressed the pilgrims on the Day of Arafah -- the most sacred day of Hajj -- publicly declaring the special spiritual station of Imam Ali (AS). After announcing divine forgiveness for the assembly generally and for Ali specifically, the Prophet called Ali to his side, held his hand before the crowd, and declared that true blessedness belongs to whoever obeys and follows Ali after the Prophet, while true wretchedness belongs to whoever disobeys Ali and harbors enmity toward him.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 3. He said: Abul Hasan ‘Ali ibn Bilal al-Mahlabi reported to me from ‘Ali ibn Abdullah ibn Asad al-Ishfahani, who reported from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi, who reported from Abdul Rahman ibn Abi Hashim, who reported from Yahya ibn al-Husayn al-Bijilli, from Abu Haroon al-Abdi, from Zadhan, who reported from Salman al-Farsi - may Allah bless him with mercy, that:

The messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, once appeared on the day of Arafah and said: "O, people, surely Allah glorified Himself because of you on this day, so that He may pardon you generally and pardon ‘Ali in particular."

Then he said: "Come near me, O ‘Ali." So ‘Ali drew near. Then the Prophet took him by his hand and said: "Surely, the blessed, completely and truly blessed is the one who obeyed you and loved you after I have gone. And surely, the wretched, completely and truly wretched is the one who disobeyed you, and showed his hostility after I have gone."
